$comment: SAMPLE. To use it: copy to the app root as APIShape.json and declare every
- calls[]: 1-64 entries, unique id (letter then [A-Za-z0-9_], max 64).
- method: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE. probe: true only on GET; ChatDock
'Test' uses it and never returns the body.
- Either path + hosts (bare hostnames, no scheme/port/path; '*' in path = one segment)
or a url that is itself a {{secret.NAME}} template (e.g. a webhook URL).
- Every call must use at least one {{secret.NAME}}; every NAME must be in
app.config.json appSecrets or scopedSecrets. No 'payload' key. Max 64 KB.
- The iframe sends only { name, action: <call id>, paramsJson }. It never sends
url, shapeJson, playgroundId, or a secret value.
